pois.name: Skyline Queenstown & Bob's Peak
pois.child_suitability: Suitable for all ages. Gondola cabins accommodate strollers and wheelchairs.
pois.description: Scenic gondola carrying visitors 450 meters up Bob's Peak for panoramic views of Lake Wakatipu, The Remarkables mountain range, and Queenstown.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic panoramic viewpoint overlooking Lake Wakatipu
✓ Top-tier photography spot capturing The Remarkables
pois.tip: Ride the luge tracks at the top of the gondola for added family adventure.

pois.name: Queenstown Gardens
pois.child_suitability: Highly child-friendly. Flat walking paths, rose gardens, duck ponds, and frisbee golf.
pois.description: Peaceful botanical botanical garden on a peninsula jutting into Lake Wakatipu, featuring exotic pine trees, rose gardens, and a lakeside walking loop.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Tranquil lakeside nature walk with mountain reflections
✓ Free public botanical gardens in walking distance of central town
pois.tip: Walk the outer perimeter path at late afternoon for golden hour views across Frankton Arm.

pois.name: Kawarau Bridge Bungy Centre
pois.address: State Highway 6, Gibbston Valley, Queenstown 9384, New Zealand
pois.child_suitability: Age restriction: Minimum age 10 years. Spectators of all ages welcome on viewing deck free of charge.
pois.description: The world's birthplace of commercial bungy jumping above the turquoise waters of the Kawarau River gorge, established by AJ Hackett in 1988.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World's first commercial bungy jumping site (1988)
✓ Spectacular suspension bridge spanning the Kawarau Gorge
pois.tip: Non-jumpers can watch from the viewing deck and museum exhibition for free.

provenance.place_verification: AJ Hackett Bungy New Zealand Official

pois.name: Shotover Jet Queenstown
pois.address: 3 Arthurs Point Road, Arthurs Point, Queenstown 9371, New Zealand
pois.child_suitability: Child policy: Minimum height 100 cm (approx. age 3-4 years). Life jackets provided.
pois.description: World-famous jet boating thrillingly skimming past towering canyon rock walls and through narrow river rapids on the Shotover River.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Queenstown adventure experience operating since 1965
✓ High-speed 360-degree spins through dramatic river canyons
pois.tip: Complimentary shuttle departs from the Queenstown town center to Arthurs Point.

pois.name: TSS Earnslaw & Walter Peak High Country Farm
pois.address: Steamer Wharf, Beach Street, Queenstown 9300, New Zealand
pois.child_suitability: Excellent for families with children. Interactive farm tour, sheep dog demonstrations, and steamship tour.
pois.description: Historic 1912 coal-fired steamship 'Lady of the Lake' cruising across Lake Wakatipu to an authentic working high country farm.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Southern Hemisphere's only operating passenger-carrying coal-fired steamship
✓ Family-friendly sheep shearing and high-country homestead visit
pois.tip: Inspect the open engine room to watch the steam stokers shoveling coal into the roaring fireboxes.

pois.name: Arrowtown Historic Gold Mining Village
pois.child_suitability: Very child-friendly. Gold panning in the Arrow River, historic candy shops, and restored cottages.
pois.description: Charming preserved 1860s Otago Gold Rush town featuring heritage cottages, European tree-lined streets, and the historic Chinese settlement.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic 1860s gold mining heritage and restored Chinese miners' settlement
✓ Picturesque avenue of historic stone cottages and Arrow River trail
pois.tip: Rent a gold pan from the Lakes District Museum to try panning for alluvial gold in the Arrow River.

pois.name: Ben Lomond Scenic Track
pois.address: Ben Lomond Track, Queenstown 9300, New Zealand
pois.child_suitability: Demanding alpine hike. Suitable for active older children and teens; not recommended for young children.
pois.description: Challenging alpine track climbing through Douglas fir forest and tussock slopes to Ben Lomond Saddle (1,326m) and Summit (1,748m).
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Premier high-alpine day trek starting right from Queenstown
✓ Unrivaled 360-degree vistas of Lake Wakatipu and the Southern Alps
pois.tip: Turn around at the Saddle if conditions are windy, as the summit ridge is steep and exposed.

pois.name: Fergburger
pois.child_suitability: Casual family dining. Highchairs and takeout packaging available.
pois.description: World-renowned Queenstown culinary institution acclaimed for gourmet New Zealand prime beef, venison, lamb, and vegetarian burgers.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Globally celebrated Queenstown dining landmark operating since 2001
✓ Premium regional New Zealand beef, venison, and plant-based burgers
pois.tip: Call ahead or order online to skip the legendary 30-minute sidewalk queue.
pois.signature_dish: The Fergburger / Holier Than Thou (Tofu & Spicy Satay)

pois.name: Bespoke Kitchen
pois.child_suitability: Family friendly cafe with outdoor courtyard seating and child options.
pois.description: Award-winning Queenstown cafe nestled below the gondola, famous for wholesome organic breakfasts, artisan baking, and extensive vegan and gluten-free menus.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Voted New Zealand Cafe of the Year
✓ Outstanding plant-based, vegetarian, and wholefood dining near the gondola
pois.tip: Enjoy breakfast in the sunny garden courtyard overlooking the pine slopes.

provenance.place_verification: NZ Cafe of the Year Official Registry

pois.name: Flame Bar & Grill Queenstown
pois.address: Steamer Wharf, Level 1, 88 Beach Street, Queenstown 9300, New Zealand
pois.child_suitability: Children welcome with dedicated kids' menu.
pois.description: Premier lakefront dining on Steamer Wharf specializing in South African-style open flame grilling with panoramic views over Queenstown Bay.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Prime waterfront dining with Lake Wakatipu sunset views
✓ Renowned open flame steaks, ribs, and grilled seafood
pois.tip: Reserve a balcony table facing Lake Wakatipu for sunset views over Walter Peak.
pois.signature_dish: Flame Signature Ribs / Chargrilled Canterbury Beef

provenance.price_source: Flame Bar & Grill Official A la Carte Menu
